task: Carry the generic Int - T early-return body from checked source through source-free ABI-v10 specialization while preserving existing Int/Float operator behavior.
observation: The original source-backed and ABI-v9 profiles returned all four expected magnitude values, including negative Float 1.5, while typed inspection showed a complete open summary with no requirements or checked body. The refresh path skipped already complete control-flow summaries, and the common checked-body reader separately required equal operand types for a generic numeric comparison. Retaining ordered checker requirements and allowing the checked mixed T/Int comparison exposed the authority needed for the common body reader and importer.
impact: A correct source/v9 baseline prevented this from being misclassified as a Float execution defect. The structured open-summary query made the missing relation visible, but did not explain why the already-complete summary lacked it; tracing the summary refresh and reader gates was necessary before ABI-v10 support could be added safely.

resolution.summary: The checker retains T < Int -> Bool and Int - T -> T from exact operation occurrences, the common occurrence lowerer emits the checked if/return body, and the source-free importer validates the ordered requirement and return relationships before projection. Independent exact-SHA adversarial review of b3ff86fa7bb44f2a3a2275ed34f5d842b829186a returned scoped GO with no P0/P1/P2 findings after independently running the four-value matrix, all five resealed hostile mutations, and preserved M2b2, Range, and Map suites.

impact: The regression showed that statement-kind matching alone would accidentally revoke an accepted loop slice. The gate now excludes only the already validated collection-loop candidate, while other unchecked While bodies stay fail-closed; the complete M2b2 suite then passed.

task: Preserve a generic assertion body and its inferred panic effect in source-free ABI-v10 projection.
observation: The generic assert probe already had a checked body, a single T > Int -> Bool requirement, and may_panic effect. A narrowly scoped importer profile could connect those facts directly: it validates the checked builtin assertion, its Bool result and operand TypeRefs, the returned parameter, and the panic effect before common projection. The source-free Debug/Release harness then passed with provider source removed and the legacy body poisoned; four resealed mutations were rejected before projection.
impact: Using the retained comparison requirement and effect summary was sufficient to support the control-flow body without inventing generic assert semantics or allowing arbitrary assertion bodies. The ABI-v9/source-backed controls and the complete surface oracle kept compatibility visible; the oracle also continued to expose the independent generic raise/recover v9 defect.
